violation_type.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Opening and Closing with 12 or Fewer Children (26 TAC §746.1709)
violation_type.short_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Opening and Closing with 12 or Fewer Children
violation_type.typical_finding: It was found the toddlers room to be over ratio when the operation adjusts ratios when combining children under 17 months old with children over 18 months old.
